scope: Stage B final slice: one link-health verdict for channels, delivery, allocation and alarm monitors

module.interface: health.Evaluate accepts requests, consecutive failures, last success, poll/timeout/maxAge and creation time; returns state, reason and age
module.unknown: No observation or creation grace returns unknown, never healthy or offline
module.no_success: Configured polling after grace without success returns offline/no_success
module.expiry: A successful poll that becomes too old returns offline/source_expired
module.degraded: Recent success with consecutive failures returns degraded/consecutive_failures
module.future: Timestamp more than 5 seconds in the future returns offline/invalid_time

adapters.channel: Channel.Health maps Stats into the shared verdict; delivery, preflight, acceptance and EMS inherit it
adapters.alarmwatch: Configured polling uses Requests=1 and raises only offline findings with the verdict reason
adapters.legacy_alerts: alerts.Monitor uses the same verdict instead of its own threshold
adapters.allocation: decision.busHealthy accepts healthy/degraded and rejects offline/unknown; lastGoodPoll's timestamp value drives freshness; allocationMember rejects unknown and accepts degraded, including capability reads
adapters.timestamps: CreatedAt uses PointTypeCreated rather than rename time; zero lastGood is no_success and future timestamps are invalid_time

verification.go_full: go test -p 1 -count=1 ./... passed (36 packages, including health)
verification.unit: Verdict table covers grace, no observation, no success, healthy, degraded, expiry, future timestamp and explicit MaxAge
verification.adapters: Alarmwatch no-success-after-grace, busHealthy fresh/stale and decision integration tests pass
verification.real_cycle: A local Modbus simulator plus real restart produced healthy, degraded, healthy recovery and offline; /ems/channels, /delivery/gates and /ems/alarms changed consistently
verification.review: Independent review found unknown allocation, negative timestamp clearing, rename-grace and a second alarmwatch verdict; all were fixed with regression tests

remaining: Stage C command/write seam and safety
Stage D history query and timeline
Stage E allocation and Modbus configuration
limits: No production device connection or physical write
No Stage F deletion, formula or public-shape changes
